capabilities: Sync tagged blocks to Readwise as highlights
Sync only notes changed since the last sync
Add block IDs for deep links back to notes
Set book title, author, tag and category
disambiguation: Not a Readwise-to-Obsidian importer; it only sends tagged notes out to Readwise, the reverse of the official Readwise plugin.
extras: Not built or endorsed by Readwise. Renaming or moving a synced note, or deleting its block ID, causes already-synced highlights to be duplicated in Readwise.
motivation: The author is an avid Readwise user and built this hobby project to review personal notes about focus-first technology and other topics.
problem: Notes written in Obsidian cannot be reviewed with Readwise's spaced repetition unless they are copied into Readwise by hand.

relations.evidence: syncs your own notes into Readwise so you can review them as "highlights"

summary: Plugin that uploads blocks carrying a chosen tag to Readwise as highlights, adding block IDs so each highlight links back to its note.
